method.inventory: SHA256/CRC32 and size rehashed per file; no duplicate SHA and no copier-header normalization in this set. User files read only.
method.static: Current loader/mapper branches, exact byte comparisons for related files, actual bank protocol interpretation. Raw LD byte candidates are explicitly not disassembly/reachability proof.
method.runtime: SMS-specific native observer, actual z80_writemem and z80_writeport forwarding, native SMS mapper/FCR/read-map snapshots and Z80 checkpoints; no MD structure is reused. Fresh process per ROM, no user saves or BIOS loaded.
method.visual: Every initial contact sheet inspected; focused later stages inspected where map/title/transition was ambiguous. Per-entry text describes observed screens; initial menu images are not called gameplay.
method.audio: PCM16 nonzero counts/peak/hash are runtime evidence; no music-recognition/perceptual-quality claim. Super Bioman silent-map ambiguity resolved by an actual stage andPSG writes.
method.self_contained: All identity, static comparisons, key native checkpoints, video/audio hashes and selected hardware writes are embedded here. Source-artifact names/hashes are provenance only; ignored raw scratch files are not needed to read this report.
method.limits: No full playthrough, every bank reachability proof, save-state regression, hardware measurement, or Windows execution claim. No source hashes are presented as independent attestation of the compiled ELF.

result: All25 exact files have evidence-backed reviewed dispositions:24 supported by existing mapping and1 compatible patched platform conversion. No confirmed core defect found in the exercised sequences. The earlier Super Bioman silence was a map mode, not a missing mapper or audio defect.
